title: Stress Level Cards on Periwinkle
whatItIs: A periwinkle rounded panel showing three tall cards, a cropped grey left card, a navy centre card 'STRESS LEVELS' with a large 'High', and a cropped right card with an orange line chart.
whatItMeans: Cropped side cards imply a swipe carousel, and the navy card with one word makes the key message unmistakable.
techniques: Single dark card among light ones as focal point
Huge one-word result at the base
Small caps card title with a short paragraph
Orange line chart as the accent

vocabulary.definition: Cards cut off at the sides to imply more.
A single large word summarising an insight.
The one card styled differently to lead the eye.
